quotes.text: Importing toolkit Rust settings also imports configuration-dependent feature lists. Entry294 removed a crashreporter feature unconditionally;297 fixed builds without MOZ_CRASHREPORTER by using the same condition before list.remove. Current gkrust/moz.build retains that guard and narrows RUST_TESTS. A normal build alone would miss sanitizer or Valgrind configuration failures; no build variants were run in this study.
